conceptZh: 酸：左邊酉（酒罈），右邊夋；酸酸的檸檬和梅子從邊邊溜進來，玩具機器人嚐到酸得臉皺成一團。
object: a boxy toy robot built from mismatched parts with one long arm, a lemon that sneaks in from the edge, and a bowl of sour plum soup
morph: pieces of 酸 sneak in from the edges of the frame, dodge the robot's reach, and settle only after he grimaces at the sour taste
creativeAngle: 字的筆畫一塊一塊從畫面邊緣偷偷溜進來，躲著玩具機器人，等他嚐一口酸梅湯皺成一團，才乖乖落定。
promptEn: An 8-second bright, clean toy-animation clip on a solid pale cream-green backdrop. Cast: one boxy toy robot built from mismatched parts, a square teal body, a round head, one long arm and one short arm, and a small mischievous round lemon with a face. The only text on screen is the single Traditional Chinese glyph 酸, drawn in saturated lime-green strokes with a slightly darker outline, ending centered, uncropped, about 70 percent of frame height with margins. 0.0-1.5s: the robot clanks in carrying a small steaming bowl of plum soup and a spoon, and a left-hand stroke piece peeks into the frame from the left edge, retreats the moment he turns his head, and a second piece peeks from the top. The first narrated 酸 lands as the robot sniffs the bowl and his eyes widen. 1.5-3.5s: the lemon rolls in from below and bumps the bowl; the robot sloshes the soup, reaches with his long arm to catch the piece peeking in from the right, which dodges up, then down, while the short arm flails at nothing; a third piece slides in behind him and tickles his antenna. The second narrated 酸 lands as the pieces finally slip together behind his back and click into the full strokes of 酸. 3.5-5.0s: the robot takes a big spoonful of plum soup; his whole face squishes, his eyes turn to spirals, his antenna curls, his short arm spins like a helicopter, and the lemon wobbles in sympathy with scrunched eyes. As the word 酸梅湯 is spoken a little round plum with a crinkly mouth bobs in the soup bowl and gives a tiny sour shiver. 5.0-8.0s: the glyph is perfectly still and clear for the last 3 seconds while the robot recovers, gives a thumbs-up with his long arm, and does a small shimmy next to the lemon on the side, away from the strokes. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks slowly and distinctly in clear Taiwanese Mandarin, clear tones, no erhua, reading exactly these syllables: 酸、酸、酸梅湯 (ㄙㄨㄢ、ㄙㄨㄢ、ㄙㄨㄢ ㄇㄟˊ ㄊㄤ). The character twice with a short pause, then the word once, then stop. The word is audio only. No background music, no extra speech, no subtitles or flashing effects; stylized toys and cartoon fruit only, no real people.

conceptZh: 玩具機器人想拿高高的酸梅，被賽車從後面撞飛，像彈珠一樣地板、賽車頭、牆壁、天花板連環彈，每撞一下就「喀」地敲進一組筆畫，最後一彈正好坐在完成的「酸」上面，咬到酸梅臉皺成一團。
object: a boxy mismatched toy robot with one long arm, a squeaky pull-back race car with googly eyes, and one big glossy sour plum hanging high
morph: the race car rear-ends the robot and launches it on a bounce chain; floor bounce clacks in the 酉 frame, race car roof bounce clacks in the inner strokes of 酉, wall bounce clacks in the 厶 and 八 on top of 夋, ceiling bounce drops the 夊 legs, and the last bounce seats the robot on top of the finished 酸
creativeAngle: 和上一版的「偷溜進來的筆畫」完全不同：這次是全程看得見的連環彈跳物理笑料。機器人馬達太強是性格也是笑點，賽車衝過頭的習慣負責啟動彈跳，每一次撞擊都對應一組清楚的筆畫（酉外框、酉內筆、厶八、夊），孩子不用聽也能看懂誰要什麼、怎麼撞、字怎麼出來。選 酸梅湯 是因為每個字只有一種讀音，而且一杯冒泡的酸梅湯和跳進去的酸梅很好畫。
promptEn:
An 8-second bright, clean toy-animation clip on a solid pale butter-yellow backdrop, nothing busy behind. Cast: one boxy toy robot built from mismatched parts, a square orange body, a dented silver head, one arm much longer than the other, motors that always run too strong, and one squeaky pull-back toy race car, cherry red with big googly eyes. Goal: one big glossy purple sour plum with a tiny puckered face dangling on a string high at the top center of the frame. The only text on screen is the single Traditional Chinese glyph 酸, drawn in thick saturated grape-purple strokes with a slightly darker outline, finishing centered, uncropped, about 70 percent of frame height with margins.

0.0-1.5s: The robot stomps in from the left, spots the plum, points up at it with the long arm and rubs its belly. It stretches the long arm up, motor whirring too hard, and the arm shoots past the plum and bonks the top of the frame, leaving the robot wobbling on tiptoe. The first narrated 酸 lands as the long arm whirs upward.

1.5-3.0s: The race car revs in from the right, googly eyes spinning, aims for the plum and of course overshoots, nose-first straight into the robot's back with a cartoon BONK. The robot squashes flat, stretches long, and launches diagonally across the frame like a pinball.

3.0-5.0s: The bounce chain. Floor bounce, BOING: the outer frame of 酉 clacks into place at the left. Bounce off the race car's roof, CLANK: the inner strokes of 酉 clack in. Wall bounce, BONK: the small 厶 and the short 八 strokes snap in at the top right. Ceiling bounce, THUNK: the 夊 legs drop into place at the bottom right. The second narrated 酸 lands as the 夊 legs click home and the whole glyph is complete. The last bounce drops the robot neatly sitting on top of 酸, dizzy, eyes spinning, antenna bent, the plum string swinging right into its long hand.

5.0-8.0s: The glyph 酸 holds perfectly still, centered and clear for the full last 3 seconds. The robot, perched on top without covering any stroke, takes one bite of the plum; its whole face scrunches, eyes squeeze shut, antenna curls into a spiral, and the short arm spins like a propeller. As the word 酸梅湯 is spoken, a tall glass of fizzing amber plum soup with a straw pops up at the lower right beside the glyph, and a second little plum plunks into it with a splash. The race car, still nose-down against the left margin, wiggles its wheels and the robot gives it a sour but happy thumbs-up.

Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks slowly and distinctly in clear Taiwanese Mandarin with clear tones and no erhua, reading exactly these syllables: 酸、酸、酸梅湯 (ㄙㄨㄢ、ㄙㄨㄢ、ㄙㄨㄢ ㄇㄟˊ ㄊㄤ). The character twice with a short pause between, then the word once, then stop. The word is audio only. Soft cartoon boing and clack sounds quieter than the voice, no music, no extra speech, no subtitles, no watermark, no flashing effects. Stylized toy figures and cartoon objects only, no real people.
